page_title: NAP 0-2 LAZ | Napoli v Lazio 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Luca Zufferli has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Giovane (Napoli) takes the corner.
90+3' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+3' The linesman makes the right call and Napoli will have a corner.
90+1' Luca Zufferli shows the yellow card to Boulaye Dia (Lazio) for a heavy challenge.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and signals a foul after Eljif Elmas (Napoli) brought his opponent down. Lazio win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
87' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
84' Giovane (Napoli) will take a corner kick.
82' Maurizio Sarri is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) suffers an injury and Elseid Hysaj comes on.
81' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' Alisson Santos (Napoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
77' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
75' Giovane (Napoli) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
74' Giovane (Napoli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
72' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Matteo Politano will be replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
71' Toma Basic will be replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
70' Matteo Politano (Napoli) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
68' Golden opportunity! Nuno Tavares (Lazio) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
66' Lazio are seeing far more of the ball now.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leonardo Spinazzola leaves the pitch and Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) comes on.
63' Substitution. Stanislav Lobotka is replaced by Giovane (Napoli).
61' The substitution has been made. Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) has replaced Mario Gila.
61' Maurizio Sarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Boulaye Dia (Lazio) replacing Mattia Zaccagni.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Patric (Lazio) comes onto the pitch for Danilo Cataldi.
60' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
59' Alisson Santos (Napoli) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
58' Luca Zufferli interrupts the game. One of the players from Lazio won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick is awarded to Napoli.

57' 0 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Toma Basic (Lazio) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the right post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, so the score changes to 0:2.
54' 0:6 – this is the current number of shots on target.
52' The ball is out of play. Lazio will take a throw-in.

50' Ambitious effort from Tijjani Noslin (Lazio). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
49' The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is replaced by Alisson Santos.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Antonio Conte probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli). He is replaced by Eljif Elmas.
46' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
43' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

42' That didn't go as planned! Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who easily kept it out.
40' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Zufferli signals.
39' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli).
37' A player from Napoli commits a rough challenge. Luca Zufferli blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Lazio get a free kick.

35' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
33' The foul by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Luca Zufferli.

31' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Vanja Milinkovic-Savic to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
31' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
29' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Luca Zufferli ignores the protests.
29' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Lazio have been awarded a penalty kick!
28' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
28' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
26' A player from Napoli commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
24' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
22' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
21' The cross into the penalty area from Matteo Politano (Napoli) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
18' The Lazio players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
15' Matteo Politano (Napoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
13' Napoli get a corner.
12' Matteo Politano (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but Edoardo Motta punches the ball away.

11' Toma Basic (Lazio) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic was alert and the score remains the same.
10' Sam Beukema (Napoli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

8' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Luca Zufferli stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a free kick to Napoli in a dangerous position.

6' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
3' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. A free kick has been awarded to Lazio.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lazio will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Luca Zufferli.
